description: Find grocery stores near a location, filtered by chain and search radius. Accepts a Swiss ZIP code, GPS coordinates, or a free-text address as the search center. Returns store name, address, chain, location, and opening hours where available. Use for "find a Migros near me", "which Coop branches are in 8001?", or before checking stock.

inputSchema.description: Find grocery stores near a location, filtered by chain and radius. Returns store name, address, location, and hours.

chains.description: Limit results to specific chains. Omit to search all configured chains.

anyOf.description: Free-text address — geocoded via Nominatim; prefer zip or lat/lng for speed

address.description: Free-text address string, e.g. "Bahnhofstrasse 1, Zürich" — geocoded via OpenStreetMap Nominatim

near.description: Center of the search radius. Pass either coordinates, a Swiss ZIP, or a free-text address.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometers (1–50). Defaults to 5 km.

name: find_stores
